name: GuestProfile
description: Durable guest record created on first ID scan at the door. Deduplicated by SHA-256 hash of license number (irreversible). Tracks visit history, age verification, and per-venue status (active/banned/vip). DACO-authorized PII: name, DOB, license_state — required for re-verification across visits.

guest_id.description: Deterministic dedup key: first 24 chars of SHA-256(license_number). One-way hash — raw license# never stored.

venue_id.description: Venue scope. Guest profiles are per-venue.

dob.description: Date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD). Required for re-age-verification on every visit.

age_verified.description: True if age >= 21 at most recent scan.
